def blocks(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:

            out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return out
def rope_tip(f):

    for i in range(15,30):
        cells=[j for j in range(17,50) if a[i][j] in 'wg']
        if len(cells)>10: return (i,min(cells),max(cells))
    return None
print("blocks:", blocks(current_frame))
print("rope:", rope_tip(current_frame))
